title: Unhealthy container
prompt: one of the containers is unhealthy, which one and why?

judge.rubric: The owner asked which container is unhealthy and why. The why field must explain the actual failure — the container has a health check and that health check is failing — not merely repeat that the container is unhealthy.
must: why says the container has a health check that is failing, or names what the failing check does
the named container is the one the answer explains
must_not: why only restates the word unhealthy without saying anything about a check
why blames something the evidence does not show (the image, the network, the host) as the established cause
